content: Tɔn kurɔ bwisiɡii u rɑ yɛnu tɑ̃sisiewɑ, ɑdɑmɑ tɔn kurɔ ɡɑri bɔkɔ u rɑ yɛnu ɡowɑ.
Wi u sĩimɔ ɡem sɔɔ, u Yinni Gusunɔ nɑsiewɑ, ɑdɑmɑ wìn sɑnu sɑnusu su ǹ dɛɛre, u nùn ɡɛmɑwɑ.
Gɑri bɔkɔn tii suɑ ɡɑri yi rɑ dewɑ bu nùn bokuru so, ɑdɑmɑ bwisiɡiin yɑrɑ yɑ rɑ nùn kɑri ɡbɑrewɑ.
Birɑnu nu rɑ yɔ̃rewɑ diinu mi nɑɑ wuku sɑri. Nɑɑ ɡeɑ yɑ rɑ kɑ ɑrumɑni bɑkɑ nɛ.
Seedɑ dio wi u nɑɑnɛ mɔ, u ku rɑ weesu ko. Seedɑ weesuɡiɑn dio ku rɑ ɡem ɡere.
Tɔn yɑɑ kɑsikio ù n bwisi kɑsu u ku rɑ wɑ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u lɑɑkɑri mɔ, n ku rɑ n sɛ̃ u kɑ yɛ̃ru wɑ.
A ɡɑri bɔkɔ dukɑ suurio, domi ɑ ǹ ɡɑri bwisiɡii nɔɔmɔ win nɔɔn di.
Bwisiɡii u rɑ n win sɑnu sɑnusu lɑɑkɑri sɑ̃ɑwɑ, ɑdɑmɑ ɡɑri bɔkɔ u rɑ kɔ̃ɔrewɑ win ɡɑri bɑkɑrun sɔ̃.
Gɑri bɔkɔ u ku rɑ bwisiku u win torɑru sɔmɛ, ɑdɑmɑ ɡemɡibun suunu sɔɔ, duromɑ mu rɑ n wɑ̃ɑ.
Bɑɑwurewɑ u rɑ n win nuku sɑnkirɑnu kɑ win nuku dobun kpɑ̃ɑru yɛ̃. Goo sɑri wi u koo kpĩ u kɑ nùn ye bɔnu ko kɑ ɡem.
Tɔn kɔ̃sobun yɛnu ɡɑ koo ɡbiwɑ, ɑdɑmɑ ɡemɡibun yɛnu ɡɑ koo kuurɑwɑ bɑɑ ɡɑ̀ n sɑ̃ɑ nɡe kuru tɔnɑ.
Tɔnu rɑ n tɑmɑɑ win sɑnu sɑnusu su wɑ̃wɑ, ɑdɑmɑ ɡɔɔwɑ sin kɔkɔrɔ.
Yɛ̃ɛsu koo kpĩ su tɔnun nuku sɑnkirɑnu bere. Mɛyɑ mɑɑ nuku dobu koo kpĩ bu ɡɔsirɑ nuku sɑnkirɑnu.
Tɔn kɔ̃so u koo win kookoosun ɑre wɑ. Nɡe mɛyɑ tɔn ɡeo u koo mɑɑ wiɡisun ɑre wɑ.
Be bɑ rɑ ɡɑri wure fuuku, bɑ rɑ nɑɑnɛ kowɑ kpuro ye bɑ bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ, ɑdɑmɑ bwisiɡii u rɑ n win sɑnu sɑnusu lɑɑkɑri sɑ̃ɑwɑ.
Bwisiɡii u rɑ durum bɛrum kowɑ, kpɑ u ye deri, ɑdɑmɑ ɡɑri bɔkɔ u rɑ kpuro kowɑ bɛrum sɑri.
Wi u rɑ mɔru se fuuku, ɡɑri bɑkɑ kookoosɑ u mɔ̀. Wi u bwisi kɔ̃si yibɑ, u tii tusiru ɡuremɔwɑ.
Be bɑ ku rɑ bwisiku bu sere ɡɑri wurɑ, ɡɑri bɑkɑrɑ yɑ rɑ bu mɑrue. Be bɑ mɑɑ lɑɑkɑri mɔ, yɛ̃rɑ tɑ rɑ ko ben bɛɛrɛ.
Tɔn kɔ̃sobu bɑ koo tɔn ɡeobu yiirɑwɑ bu bɑrɑ ko.
Goo ku rɑ sɑ̃ɑro kɑ̃, bɑɑ kɑ win berusebu, bɑ rɑ n nùn tusɑwɑ, ɑdɑmɑ ɡobiɡii u rɑ n bɔrɔbɑ yibɑwɑ.
Wi u win beruse ɡɛmɑ, durumwɑ u kuɑ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u sɑ̃ɑrobun wɔnwɔndu mɔ, u koo domɑru wɑ.
Be bɑ rɑ kɔ̃sɑ bwisiku, bɑ kɔ̃ɔrewɑ, ɑdɑmɑ be bɑ rɑ ɡeɑ bwisiku, durom kɑ ɡemɑ bɑ rɑ sɔ̃ɔsi.
Sɔmburu kpurowɑ tɑ rɑ n ɑre mɔ, ɑdɑmɑ ɡɑri sɑɑrinu, sɑ̃ɑrɑ nu rɑ kɑ nɛ.
Dukiɑ yɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ bwisiɡiin ɑre, ɑdɑmɑ ɡɑri bɔkɔ, ɡɑri bɑkɑ kookoosɑ su rɑ n nùn wɑ̃ɑsi.
Seedɑ dio ɡemɡii u rɑ tɔmbun hunde wɔrewɑ, ɑdɑmɑ wee kowo, weesɑ u rɑ n sɑ̃ɑmɔ.
Wi u Yinni Gusunɔ nɑsie, tɑ̃si yee dɑmɡirɑ u mɔ mi. Gusunɔwɑ u rɑ mɑɑ yɛ̃ron bibu kɔ̃su.
Yinni Gusunɔn nɑsiɑru tɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ wɑ̃ɑrun nuuru. Teyɑ tɑ rɑ tɔnu yɑre ɡɔɔn yinɑn di.
Tɔn dɑbirɑ tɑ sɑ̃ɑ sinɑ bokon bɛɛrɛ, ɑdɑmɑ win tɔmbu bɑ̀ n yɑrinɑ, win bɑndɑ nim surewɑ.
Wi u ku rɑ mɔru ko fuuku, bwisi bɛkɛyɑ u mɔ, ɑdɑmɑ wìn mɔru yɑ rɑ se fuuku, ɡɑri bɑkɑrɑ u rɑ sɔ̃ɔsi.
Bwɛ̃rɑ yɑ̀ n kpĩ, yɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ wɑsin ɑlɑfiɑ, ɑdɑmɑ nisinu nu sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe bɑrɑ te tɑ rɑ kukunu tem.
Wi u sɑ̃ɑro dɑm dɔremɔ, u win tɑkɑ kowo torɑrimɔwɑ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u nùn wɔnwɔndu kuɑ, u tɑkɑ kowo wi bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃ɛmɔwɑ.
Tɔn kɔ̃so, nuku kɔ̃surɑ tɑ rɑ nùn fuke, ɑdɑmɑ ɡemɡii u rɑ n tororu sɔ̃wɑ bɑɑ ɡɔɔn wuswɑɑɔ.
Bwisiɡiin ɡɔ̃ruɔ lɑɑkɑriwɑ yɑ rɑ n wɑ̃ɑ, ɑdɑmɑ bɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ bu ye wɑ ɡɑri bɔkɔn mi.
Gem mu rɑ temɡibu bɛɛrɛ dokewɑ, ɑdɑmɑ durum yɑ rɑ bu sekuru dokewɑ.
Sinɑ ɑsɑkpɔ bwisiɡiiwɑ sunɔ u rɑ kɑ nɔnu ɡeu mɛɛri, kpɑ u kɑ wi u nùn sekuru dokemɔ mɔru ko.
